Metric: PairAcc averages positive–negative wins within each item, then across items; a tie receives 1/2. Its chance value stays at 0.500 for every option count. Scope: graph-role guarantees apply to
the declared intervention family; detector AP is a selected-positive subset metric.
Selected references: FG-OVD (Bianchi et al., 2024); CREPE (Ma et al., 2023); CLIP (Radford et al., 2021); FG-CLIP (Xie et al., 2025); OWLv2 (Minderer et al., 2023); NoctOWLv2 (Bianchi, 2025).
Evidence: frozen ORBIT-VISUAL v5 and paired released-checkpoint evaluations.
